data.case_title: School entry examination invitation for Paula
data.explanation: This letter invites you to bring your child Paula to a mandatory school entry health check (Schuleingangsuntersuchung) before she starts school. Bring the yellow child examination booklet, the vaccination card, and glasses or hearing aids if she uses them. The examination is free and takes about an hour. If the appointment time doesn't work for you, call the office at the number given to arrange another date. No other preparation or payment is required.
